method: Two independent transcriptions of Harper's printed transliteration from page images (no OCR text used): pass A from the Toronto scan, pass B from the Cornell scan. 2,543 of 2,816 stele lines agreed exactly; 246 differed only in diacritics lost in the faint Toronto print (Cornell reading taken); the remaining disagreements were settled by eye against the Cornell scan (field 'resolved'; pass A's reading kept in 'passA').
notation: Harper's characters as printed: š ṣ ṭ ḫ ḳ (= q), circumflex and macron vowels, sign-index accents (á à …). Raised text in braces: {b} (Harper's raised b), {ilu}, {amêlu}, {kam}, {(?)}; {1} = footnote marker (footnotes in 'apparatus'). Line-break hyphens inside words Harper elsewhere writes unhyphenated (šamal-lûm, sipar-rim, mal-aḫim) are kept as printed and need normalising at build.
scope_note: The Prologue and §1–41 (stele i 1 – xii 62) are already published from Harper (hammurabi-prologue, -litany, -laws-1-10, -11-25, -26-41). The erased section (≈§66–99, five columns cut from the stone in antiquity) is NOT in Harper; it is to be supplied from duplicate tablets and marked as such — see claude/hammurabi-completion-plan-2026-10-11.md.
